title: Database saturation and connection-pool exhaustion
root_cause: Database latency and connection-pool saturation can block checkout requests.
resolution: Propose a reversible pool or load mitigation after checking the database; require approval for replica changes and block direct database mutations.
pattern: high API latency with elevated database p95 and exhausted connections
diagnostic: Check database p95, active connections, query volume, queue depth and deployments. Compare provider and cache health.
text: Synthetic V2 runbook. High database latency plus exhausted connection pools supports database overload. An absent recent deployment weakens deployment regression but does not prove the database hypothesis. A healthy database is evidence against overload. Do not blindly increase pool limits: they may increase server load. Verify recovery with both API and database metrics.
